US Court Halts Trump White House Ballroom Project

A federal appeals court in the US has ordered a halt to a $400 million White House construction project for a new ballroom. The court ruled that the project requires Congressional approval, which has not been obtained. The ruling follows a challenge by the National Trust for Historic Preservation. Former President Donald Trump has called the decision a "national security threat" and a "national disgrace," and plans to appeal the ruling to the Supreme Court.
